name: extension-points
title: Extension points
description: How far you can bend the product, from no-code to code: custom fields, rules, webhooks, plugins and the API, each with its level, examples and a guide.
docs: Pass levels (an id, a label and, if you like, a description) from the least technical to the most, and points (a name, the id of its level, a description, example chips and a guide link). The levels set the order of the ladder, so it can never be shown upside down, and the level is always written out beside the name. A step marker on the left grows by one bar on every row; it is decoration and hidden from assistive technology, because the list is an ordered list. When any level has a description a key above the ladder says what each level takes; the levels sit in equal columns by their number, or stack, and never as two and one. Add a footnote for the promise that answers the fear of lock-in. The block has no state and renders on the server.
